sourceFrames.reason: Within Sima Teng’s biography, 惠帝討成都王穎，六軍敗績 expressly names the emperor, and 穎懼，挾帝歸洛陽 refers back to that same emperor. The surrounding campaign, promotions and ensuing Yongjia introduction keep this frame separate from the later family succession.

Que succeeds Teng, then the line passes through adopted heirs Bi and Miao, Miao’s son Huang, then Huang’s brother Chong. 孝武帝立晃弟崇繼邈後 identifies Xiaowu as the installing emperor; 為奴所害，子惠立 then makes Hui the son/successor of Chong. It cannot name the much earlier campaign emperor Hui. Song’s abolition of the fief closes this genealogy.
